# Activity 03: Group activity — fix a search page

**Use lessons 01–10.** The task and solution have identical HTML. Work in a group to repair the deliberately scrambled CSS in `task/styles.css`. Do not edit `index.html`.

1. Give students the [student guide](task/GUIDE.txt). Open the [student task](task/index.html) and compare it with the [expected result](solution/index.html).
2. Change only CSS values in `task/styles.css` to fix the page background, wordmark colors and size, search field, button styles, and spacing. Its selectors and properties already match the solution.
3. Resize the browser to check that the search area still fits on a narrow screen.

**Done when:** The task page looks close to the solution at desktop and phone widths, and the group can explain which CSS rules it changed.
